methodology: On BNB same block, gasUsed(target) = cumulativeGasUsed(target receipt) - cumulativeGasUsed(immediately preceding tx receipt). Strict adjacent transaction indices, exact same block. Do not use ETH tx gas limit or EOA block delta as receipt gas.
read_plan: For each of 3 frozen buys, exactly 1 ethGetTransactionByBlockNumberAndIndex(block, target_index-1) to obtain previous tx hash
Then exactly 1 ethGetTransactionReceipt for each preceding tx hash (3 calls); require same block and adjacent index, parse cumulativeGasUsed if available
For E11B target buy only, exactly 1 ethGetTransactionReceipt to read cumulativeGasUsed (D503 prior target receipt cum values already Git-pinned)

Any API/provider output truncated must NOT be claimed a full raw receipt; if cumulativeGasUsed exact field visible and neighbor identity independently valid, label as DERIVED_FROM_TOOL_VISIBLE_CUMULATIVE_FIELDS_NOT_FULL_PROVIDER_WIRE
If any target cumulative or prev cumulative missing/inconsistent -> leave gasUsed UNKNOWN; no retry/no new tx discovery

Result is historical actual transaction gas units when adjacency checks hold; fee requires tx gasPrice for legacy type0, receipt effectiveGasPrice if available; don't claim refund/tax/internal BNB flow closure
warning: This is not a public observer U or an original DDAC follower PnL demonstration; external D503 entered after DDAC exited; E11B exit unresolved.
